findings.evidence: MapTopology.lean `def mapCLE … := ((ofCompactlySupportedCLE e U he hcover).symm.trans (mapCompactlySupportedCLE …)).trans (ofCompactlySupportedCLE d U hd hcover)`. The Hom version, `exact ((BundleTest.ofCompactlySupportedCLE … source U hs hcover).symm.trans (CompactlySupported.homComplexificationCLE …)).trans (BundleTest.ofCompactlySupportedCLE … target U ht hcover)`, has the same shape.
findings.fix: Define it as `BundleTest.mapCLE e d U hs ht hcover φ hφ hφ' A B hA hB`, with `A`/`B` from `Complexification.continuousLinearMapEquiv`, as `CompactlySupported.homComplexificationCLE` already does. Derive the evaluation lemmas from `mapCLE_apply` and `mapCLE_symm_apply`.
findings.issue: `TauCeti.BundleTest.homComplexificationCLE` rebuilds the native-test chain by hand (`ofCompactlySupportedCLE.symm.trans (CompactlySupported.homComplexificationCLE …) |>.trans ofCompactlySupportedCLE`). That chain is exactly the body of the generic `BundleTest.mapCLE` the PR adds. Its `_toLinearEquiv`, `_apply` and `_symm_apply` lemmas therefore repeat `mapCLE_toLinearEquiv`, `mapCLE_apply` and `mapCLE_symm_apply`.

findings.evidence: MapTopology.lean `theorem tsupport_mapCLE` has the same statement and proof shape: `congr 1; ext x; simp … LinearEquiv.map_ne_zero_iff`.
findings.fix: Once `homComplexificationCLE` is defined through `mapCLE`, obtain it from `tsupport_mapCLE` (or drop it).
findings.issue: `BundleTest.tsupport_homComplexificationCLE` re-proves the support-preservation argument that the generic `BundleTest.tsupport_mapCLE` already covers.

findings.evidence: MapTopology.lean:46 `theorem mapCompactlySupportedEquiv_ofSupportedIn (K : Compacts M) (s : supportedIn I F n V K) : mapCompactlySupportedEquiv φ hφ hφ' (ofSupportedIn K s) = ofSupportedIn K (mapSupportedInEquiv φ hφ hφ' K s)`. The Hom maps are definitionally `mapCompactlySupportedEquiv`/`mapSupportedInEquiv` at the same `φ`.
findings.fix: Prove the first as `mapCompactlySupportedEquiv_ofSupportedIn _ _ _ K s` (or drop it), and the second directly from `tsupport_mapEquiv`.
findings.issue: `CompactlySupported.homComplexificationEquiv_ofSupportedIn` is a special case of the generic `mapCompactlySupportedEquiv_ofSupportedIn`, added in this PR, but it is proved again by unfolding (`Subtype.ext`, `ext`, `simp`). `CompactlySupported.tsupport_homComplexificationEquiv` likewise re-derives support preservation that the generic `tsupport_mapEquiv` already gives (it is proved from `ContMDiffSection.tsupport_homComplexificationEquiv`, which is just `tsupport_mapEquiv`).

summary: The generic MapTopology transport fixes both prior generality findings, but four Hom declarations repeat proofs instead of using that generic API. `BundleTest.homComplexificationCLE`, its support lemma and two compact-stage lemmas each duplicate something the PR already proves in general.
